title: MASEMiner — TAS-20
tagline: Extract TAS-20 factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study metadata for MASEM
description: TAS-20-tuned MASEMiner variant. Sets the three-factor item-to-factor mapping (DIF / DDF / EOT) as a CFA fallback. Item content is NOT pre-loaded (the TAS-20 item texts are copyrighted) — paste them yourself in section C of the builder if you want the model to match reordered or paraphrased items by content rather than by item number.
task_description: Extract TAS-20 factor-analytic data: item-level factor loadings (F1.1–F5.20), inter-factor correlations (R1.2–R4.5), and study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: Papers report TAS-20 psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Standard three-factor structure: F1 = DIF, F2 = DDF, F3 = EOT. Item content is pre-loaded so the model can match reordered or paraphrased items.

template_params._item_texts_note: Intentionally empty — TAS-20 items are copyrighted (Bagby, Parker & Taylor, 1994). Users paste their own copy of the items into the builder's section C if they want the model to match by item content rather than item number.
